answer: Ambient Signal Lock requires each agent to feed a local sensor cluster's noise into a verification kernel that hashes to a shared sable ledger every ninety seconds. Any identity failing to produce a physically-unique reading in time has its transaction prism dissolved and transfers voided. The per-identity cost for a sybil attacker is physically co-locating a sensor rig at every claimed node, so one hundred fake IDs means one hundred real hardware placements.
